name: Mohabbati Rutt
overview: Mohabbati Rutt follows Bindri, who loses his parents in childhood and is raised by a caring neighbour, Aunt Shinder. Along with his inseparable friends Forman and Chiddhi, he shares a strong bond built on friendship, laughter, and dreams of marriage. As the three friends move through life together, the film celebrates friendship, love, emotions, and relationships.
